'''''ONE Friday Fights 137: Tawanchai vs. Liu''''' (also known as '''''ONE Lumpinee 137''''') was a [[combat sport]]s event produced by [[ONE Championship]] that took place on December 19, 2025, at [[Lumpinee Boxing Stadium]] in [[Bangkok]], Thailand.

===background===
A featherweight Kickboxing bout between current [[ONE Featherweight Muay Thai World Championship|ONE Featherweight Muay Thai World Champion]] [[Tawanchai P.K. Saenchaimuaythaigym|Tawanchai P.K.Saenchai]] and Liu Mengyang was headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-12-14 |title=Full Card Revealed for ONE Friday Fights 137 on December 19
|url=https://www.onefc.com/news/full-card-revealed-for-one-friday-fights-137-on-december-19/ |access-date=2025-12-15 |website=ONE Championship – The Home Of Martial Arts |language=en-US}}</ref>

===Bonus awards===
The following fighters received $10,000 bonuses:
*'''Performance of the Night: Sam-A Gaiyanghadao, Mohammad Siasarani, Yod-IQ Or.Pimonsri, Gingsanglek Tor.Laksong, Suriyanlek Por.Yenying''' and '''Duangdawnoi Looksaikongdin'''

'''''ONE Friday Fights 138: Pompet vs. Decho''''' (also known as '''''ONE Lumpinee 138''''') was a [[combat sport]]s event produced by [[ONE Championship]] that took place on January 16, 2026, at [[Lumpinee Boxing Stadium]] in [[Bangkok]], Thailand.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-12 |title=Full Card Revealed for ONE Friday Fights 138 on January 16

===Background===
A flyweight Muay Thai bout between Pompet Panthonggym and [[Decho Por.Borirak]] was headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-06 |title= Pompet vs. Decho Flyweight Muay Thai Clash Headlines ONE Friday Fights 138 
|url=https://www.onefc.com/news/pompet-vs-decho-flyweight-muay-thai-clash-headlines-one-friday-fights-138/ |access-date=2026-01-06 |website=ONE Championship – The Home Of Martial Arts |language=en-US}}</ref>

'''''ONE Fight Night 40: Buntan vs. Hemetsberger 2''''' was a [[combat sport]]s event produced by [[ONE Championship]] that took place on February 14, 2026, at [[Lumpinee Boxing Stadium]] in [[Bangkok]], Thailand.<ref>{{Cite web |title=ONE Fight Night 40: Buntan vs. Hemetsberger 2 |url=https://www.onefc.com/events/onefightnight40/ |access-date=2026-01-17 |website=ONE Championship – The Home of Martial Arts |language=en-US}}</ref>

===Background===
A [[ONE Women's Strawweight World Championship|ONE Women's Strawweight Kickboxing World Championship]] bout between current Champion [[Jackie Buntan]] and current [[ONE Women's Strawweight Muay Thai World Championship|ONE Women's Strawweight Muay Thai World Champion]] [[Stella Hemetsberger]]  headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-12-18 |title=งานแก้มือ! "แจ็กกี" ป้องบัลลังก์คิกบ็อกซิ่ง ดวลคู่ปรับเก่า "สเตลลา" ศึก ONE Fight Night 40
|url=https://www.onefc.com/th/news/jackie-buntan-to-defend-her-title-against-stella-hemetsberger-at-one-fight-night-40/ |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=ONE Championship – The Home Of Martial Arts |language=th-TH}}</ref> The pairing previously met at [[ONE Fight Night 35]] in September 2025, in Women's Strawweight Muay thai World Title bout, when Hemetsberger captured the vacant title by unanimous decision.

An interim [[ONE Featherweight Muay Thai World Championship]] bout between [[Shadow Singha Mawynn]] and [[Nico Carrillo]]  served as the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-08 |title=ONE Championship: Shadow to Face Nico Carrillo for Interim Featherweight Muay Thai Title
|url=https://www.bangkokpost.com/sports/3171520/one-championship-shadow-to-face-nico-carrillo-for-interim-featherweight-muay-thai-title |access-date=2026-01-19 |website=Bangkok Post |language=en-US}}</ref>

At the weigh-ins, one fighter failed to hydration test and missed weight for their respective fights:<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-02-13 |title=ผลชั่งน้ำหนักและวัดระดับน้ำ ศึก ONE Fight Night 40: แจ็กกี vs. สเตลลา 2|url=https://www.onefc.com/th/news/weight-and-hydration-results-of-one-fight-night-40/ |access-date=2026-02-13 |website=ONE Championship – The Home Of Martial Arts |language=th-TH}}</ref>
*Joao Pedro Bueno Mendes weighted in at 158.6 pounds, 3.6 pounds over the featherweight limit and he was fined 30 percent of his purse which went to Fabricio Andrey.

'''''ONE Fight Night 41: Sinsamut vs. Jarvis''''' was a [[combat sport]]s event produced by [[ONE Championship]] that took place on March 14, 2026, at [[Lumpinee Boxing Stadium]] in [[Bangkok]], Thailand.<ref>{{Cite web |title=ONE Fight Night 41: Sinsamut vs. Jarvis |url=https://www.onefc.com/events/onefightnight41/ |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=ONE Championship – The Home of Martial Arts |language=en-US}}</ref>

===Background===
A [[ONE Women's Atomweight Muay Thai World Championship]] bout between current champion [[Allycia Rodrigues]] and current [[ONE Women's Atomweight Kickboxing World Championship|ONE Women's Atomweight Kickboxing World champion]] [[Phetjeeja Lukjaoporongtom]] was scheduled to headline the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-29 |title=ONE Championship: Allycia Rodrigues vs. Phetjeeja to Headline ONE Fight Night 41 on March 14, per Source
|url=https://www.bangkokpost.com/sports/3185968/one-championship-allycia-rodrigues-vs-phetjeeja-to-headline-one-fight-night-41-on-march-14-per-source |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=Bangkok Post |language=en-US}}</ref> However, The bout was canceled after both fighters has an injury.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-03-05 |title=ONE Championship: Reshuffles ONE Fight Night 41 Card as Rodrigues and Phetjeeja Withdraw Injured
|url=https://www.bangkokpost.com/sports/3210468/one-championship-reshuffles-one-fight-night-41-card-as-rodrigues-and-phetjeeja-withdraw-injured |access-date=2026-03-05 |website=Bangkok Post |language=en-US}}</ref> Therefore, a lightweight Muay Thai bout between [[Sinsamut Klinmee]] and [[George Jarvis (Muay Thai)|George Jarvis]] headlined the event.

A [[ONE Welterweight Submission Grappling World Championship]] bout between current champion [[Tye Ruotolo]] and promotional newcomer Paweł Jaworski served as the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-25 |title=แกร่งชนแกร่ง! "ไท" ได้คิวรั้งเข็มขัดปล้ำจับล็อกจาก "พาเวล" ศึก ONE Fight Night 41
|url=https://www.onefc.com/th/news/tye-ruotolo-to-defend-welterweight-submission-grappling-title-against-pawel-jaworski-at-one-fight-night-41/ |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=ONE Championship – The Home Of Martial Arts |language=th-TH}}</ref>

At the weigh-ins, three fighters failed to hydration test and missed weight for their respective fights:<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-03-13 |title=ผลชั่งน้ำหนักและวัดระดับน้ำ ศึก ONE Fight Night 41: สินสมุทร vs. จอร์จ|url=https://www.onefc.com/th/news/weight-and-hydration-results-of-one-fight-night-41/ |access-date=2026-03-13 |website=ONE Championship – The Home Of Martial Arts |language=th-TH}}</ref>
*Suablack Tor.Pran49 weighted in at 139.8 pounds, 4.8 pounds over the flyweight limit and he was fined 30 percent of his purse which went to Hyu Iwata.
*Marcos Aurélio weighted in at 151.6 pounds, 6.6 pounds over the bantamweight limit.
*Mauro Mastromarini weighted in at 148.6 pounds, 3.6 pounds over the bantamweight limit.

===Bonus awards===
The following fighters received $50,000 bonuses:
*'''Performance of the Night: Hyu Iwata'''

*Diego Paez weighted in at 140.4 pounds, 5.4 pounds over the flyweight limit and he was fined 30 percent of his purse which went to Black Panther VenumMuaythai.
*Mohanad Battbootti weighted in at 148.6 pounds, 3.6 pounds over the bantamweight limit and he was fined 30 percent of his purse which went to Dmitrii Kovtun.

===Background===
An interim [[ONE Flyweight Kickboxing World Championship]] bout between Former [[ONE Flyweight Muay Thai World Championship|ONE Flyweight Muay Thai World champion]] [[Rodtang Jitmuangnon]] and Former 3 Division K-1 Champion [[Takeru Segawa]] headlined the event. A [[ONE Flyweight World Championship]] bout between current champion [[Yuya Wakamatsu]] and [[Avazbek Kholmirzaev]] served as the event.

A ONE Atomweight Muay Thai World Championship bout between current champion [[Nadaka Yoshinari]] and [[Songchainoi Kiatsongrit]] served as the event.

A [[ONE Bantamweight Kickboxing World Championship]] bout between current champion (also former [[ONE Bantamweight Muay Thai World Championship|ONE Bantamweight]] and [[ONE Flyweight Muay Thai World Championship|Flyweight Muay Thai World champion]]) [[Jonathan Haggerty]] and [[Yuki Yoza]] served as the event.

'''''ONE Fight Night 44: Jarvis vs. Rungrawee 2''''' was a [[combat sport]]s event produced by [[ONE Championship]] that took place on June 27, 2026, at [[Lumpinee Boxing Stadium]] in [[Bangkok]], Thailand.<ref>{{Cite web |title=ONE Fight Night 44: Jarvis vs. Rungrawee 2 |url=https://www.onefc.com/events/onefightnight44/ |access-date=2026-05-20 |website=ONE Championship – The Home of Martial Arts |language=en-US}}</ref>

===Background===
A lightweight Muay Thai rematch between [[George Jarvis (Muay Thai)|George Jarvis]] and [[Rungrawee Sitsongpeenong]] headlined the event. The pairing previously met at [[2024 in ONE Championship#ONE Friday Fights 85|ONE Friday Fights 85]] in November 2024, which Jarvis won by knockout in third round.

At the weigh-ins, four fighters failed to hydration test and missed weight for their respective fights:<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-06-26 |title=ผลชั่งน้ำหนักและวัดระดับน้ำ ศึก ONE Fight Night 44: จอร์จ vs. รุ่งราวี 2|url=https://www.onefc.com/th/news/weight-and-hydration-results-of-one-fight-night-44/ |access-date=2026-06-26 |website=ONE Championship – The Home Of Martial Arts |language=th-TH}}</ref>
*[[George Jarvis (Muay Thai)|George Jarvis]] weighted in at 171.2 pounds, 1.2 pounds over the lightweight limit and he was fined 30 percent of his purse which went to [[Rungrawee Sitsongpeenong]].
*Johan Estupiñan weighted in at 139.2 pounds, 4.2 pounds over the flyweight limit and he was fined 30 percent of his purse which went to Akif Guluzada.
*Charlie Guest weighted in at 160.2 pounds, 5.2 pounds over the featherweight limit and he was fined 30 percent of his purse which went to Samuel Fitzgerald.
*Owen Jones weighted in at 158.6 pounds, 3.6 pounds over the featherweight limit and he was fined 30 percent of his purse which went to Fabricio Andrey.

===Background===
A featherweight Muay Thai bout between Luke Lessei and Mohamed Younes Rabah headlined the event.

At the weigh-ins, three fighters failed to hydration test and missed weight for their respective fights:<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-07-17 |title=ผลชั่งน้ำหนักและวัดระดับน้ำ ศึก ONE Fight Night 45: ลุค vs. โมฮาเหม็ด|url=https://www.onefc.com/th/news/weight-and-hydration-results-of-one-fight-night-45/ |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=ONE Championship – The Home Of Martial Arts |language=th-TH}}</ref>
*Antonio Cesar weighted in at 141.4 pounds, 6.4 pounds over the flyweight limit and he was fined 30 percent of his purse which went to Lito Adiwang.
*Felipe Lobo weighted in at 145.4 pounds, 0.4 pounds over the bantamweight limit and he was fined 30 percent of his purse which went to Dmitrii Kovtun.
*Sean Climaco weighted in at 135.4 pounds, 0.4 pounds over the flyweight limit and he was fined 30 percent of his purse which went to Black Panther VenumMuaythai.

===Bonus awards===
The following fighters received $50,000 bonuses:
